journey.name: Demo app test
journey.description: Verify that a Respect-compatible app can be added, opened and used to complete a lesson.

actions.action: Check app with id - world.respect.app is installed on the device
Check app with id - <TEST_APP_ID> is installed on the device
Launch the world.respect.app.
If a "Get Started" screen is displayed, tap the "Get Started" button.
On the "Let's get started screen", click on "Other options" button which is at the bottom.This should take user to - another screen.
Tap on "Paste the link here"
Type the school URL - '<SCHOOL_URL>' into the text field just above the Next button
Then tap "Next".
Verify user is on the login screen
Type "<USERNAME>" into the Username field.
Type "<PASSWORD>" into the Password field.
Tap the Login.
If a dialog titled "Save password for Respect?" appears, tap "Cancel".
Verify the RESPECT home screen is displayed.
On the home screen check -"<APP_NAME>" is visible. If yes skip next 10 steps.
On the home screen, tap the "Add" button.
Tap "Add from Link".
Verify "Link*" named text field is visible
Type '<APP_MANIFEST_LINK>' into the "Link*" text field.
Then Tap "Next" button just below.
Verify the app details page is displayed.
Verify "<APP_NAME>" is shown on the app details page.
Verify "Lessons" is available on the app details page.
Tap "Add to school apps", If already added, skip this step
Tap on "Home" button at bottom tab
Verify "<APP_NAME>" appears in the Apps list.
Tap "<APP_NAME>".
Verify the page title "App detail" is displayed.
Tap on "Lessons" arrow mark.
Verify the lesson list is visible.
Tap on the first-Grade
Verify sub-lesson list is visible
Tap on the first-lesson
Verify the lesson title is matching the lesson selected
Verify the app name is visible
Verify "Download" option is available.
Tap on "Open" above the download button.
Verify user is on screen with title - "Grade 1 learning unit #1".
Enter "0.5" into the field located just below "Scaled score".
Tap the "Send result statement" button.
Tap the "Send completed statement" button.
Tap on "Close" icon on the title.
Verify the user is back on the lesson detail screen.
Repeat step 25 to step 43 replacing first-Grade with third-Grade , first-lesson with third-lesson and "Grade 1 learning unit #1" with "Grade 3 learning unit #3".
